column7: IssueMachineToken's MACH-001 privilege-ceiling check (requireMachinePrivilegeCeiling) was called with a hardcoded (ActorTypeUser, actorID) pair instead of the real calling principal; actorID is audit attribution only and is always 0 for a machine caller (ADR-030), so the ceiling always evaluated "user 0, no roles" and refused every machine actor unconditionally even though both the HTTP and gRPC route gates in front of this call already admit a machine actor holding roles.assign (authzdiff cross-layer differential harness waiver known-03, historical name D3). Fixed by threading actor.ActorKind()/actor.PrincipalID() through two new parameters.
